text:
auditor_kim: Hi all — auditing CC6/ISO control. We found an RBAC change (rolebinding rb-1307) during a vuln triage on 2026-03-04. Requesting: raw KMS logs showing no external key export, a short rollback timeline/note, and remediation evidence for CVE-2026-0210. Please paste artifacts or presigned paths.

leo-sec: Thanks, kim. We'll assemble a tarball. Quick Q: prefer raw CloudTrail JSON + SIEM correlation, or a signed manifest + hashes?

auditor_kim: Raw CloudTrail preferred; manifest is fine as supplementary. Need HMAC of any envelope proofs if you have them.

toni-sre: Pulling events now. I'll upload to presigned S3: s3://redwood-evidence/1809998881/ (files: cloudtrail_kms_1809998881.json.gz, siem_alerts_1809998881.log.gz, rb-1307-rollback.txt, cve-0210-mitigation.md, manifest.sha256.sig)

jamie-eng: Rollback note (short):
"Reverted rolebinding rb-1307 at 2026-03-04T09:11:02Z after automated canary detected broader-than-intended permission grant. Rollback executed by jamie-eng via ops playbook v2.7. Canary green at 09:16Z. Ticket: SEC-4182."

leo-sec: CloudTrail snippet (excerpt):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-03-04T09:08:45Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-1" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456" },
  "responseElements": { "ciphertextBlob": "..." }
}
```

leo-sec: Note — no Decrypt events with external recipient metadata observed in the window 09:00-10:00Z. We generated an envelope-proof file with base64 HMAC: s3://redwood-evidence/1809998881/kms-envelope-hmac.txt. HMAC verified locally against CMK ck-21.

evidence-bot: Automated check: manifest.sha256.sig verified (key id ck-17). Filesize and hashes match uploaded bundle.

auditor_kim: Great. Two small follow-ups: 1) paste rb-1307 rollback txt (first 2 lines) inline, 2) provide PR link for CVE fix and the deploy tag/IDs.

jamie-eng: rb-1307-rollback.txt (excerpt):
"Revert rb-1307 applied 2026-03-04T09:11:02Z by jamie-eng. Reason: canary permission expansion. No external principals observed. Post-revert monitoring window 15m clean. See SEC-4182."

toni-sre: CVE PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/security/pull/1350
Deploys: deploy-usw2-20260304-7, rolling-canary-20260304-3

auditor_kim: Thanks. Final ask: any CMK policy edits during the event window? If yes, include diff; if no, confirm.

leo-sec: Confirmed — no PutKeyPolicy, DisableKey, or ScheduleKeyDeletion events for key ef12-3456 between 2026-03-04T08:30Z and 2026-03-04T10:00Z. There is an unrelated policy update on 2026-02-20 recorded.

auditor_kim: Perfect. I'll attach these to the SOC2 packet and map to control CC6.2 / A.9.2.1. If we need signed attestations, I'll follow up. :thumbsup:
